usage: Media buy / deal booking confirmation after human-in-the-loop approval — shows the booked media buy ID, committed budget, product, flight, and estimated impressions (OpenDirect 2.1 / Deals API order).

dataMapping.media_buy_id: Booked media buy / deal identifier (e.g., mb_2024_espn_001 or DEAL-1234)
dataMapping.product_name: Product / inventory name that was booked
dataMapping.estimated_impressions: Estimated impressions for the booked buy (number)
